about: Chorus edit (spec 2026-11-02 §5.3, then the author's post-production after the lip-sync trial). Each pass is a list of segments. A 'take' segment plays a take at the lag motion-kit/tools/sync_check.py measured (sync = its sync.json, relative to ep01/v2); a 'still' segment is an approved plate moved by the code camera from 'from' to 'to' ([centre x, centre y, zoom] in plate px); a 'take' with from/to is framed by the code camera like a still. 'span' [first shot, shot after] makes split segments share one camera move over that whole stretch, so a cutaway does not restart it. A later segment starts at a lyric line's vocal entry ('at_line'), on one word ('at_word' [line, word]), both two frames early like build.py's vocal(), or on the last eighth note before a take stops being in sync ('eighth_before_sync_end_of'). Sung lines are drawn in the EV 'stack' mode on the left (main.js). Earlier edits: chorus-c4.json, chorus-c6.json.
